main.innovative: Emergency streaming allows you to record video and audio while automatically saving them to a secure server, immediately notifying trusted users and granting them access to what is happening. Even in unstable or dangerous situations, you are not left alone, and recorded events will be preserved.
main.benefits_title: Who the app may be useful for
main.benefits_anyone_title: For those who care about their own safety and the safety of loved ones
main.citizen: For people who witness dangerous or unjust situations and want to document what is happening without facing it alone.
main.journalists: Journalists, private investigators, and security professionals can use the app to document events and collect evidence with remote storage and trusted user notifications.
main.adventurers: Travelers and explorers who find themselves in remote or potentially dangerous locations can use the app to record their route and events while ensuring data is securely stored on the server.
main.anyone: For anyone who cares about the safety of their family, children, and loved ones, and wants the ability to document a concerning or potentially dangerous situation with data preservation and immediate notification of trusted users.
main.discreet: Button-based activation: Start recording with a single tap, without complex actions, to quickly capture what is happening.
main.immediate: Automatic upload: Recordings are saved to a secure server as they are created, reducing the risk of data loss in unstable situations.
main.friendly: Trusted user notifications: People you trust receive a notification when recording starts and can gain access to the live stream and information about your location.
main.quality: Data integrity control: Recordings are stored together with parameters and additional information, forming a coherent context of the recorded events, with the possibility of further verification of the recording's authenticity.
main.advanced: Data protection and privacy: Access to recordings is restricted and granted only to you and users you explicitly authorize.

how_to_use.how_use_1: Register with your email address and confirm your account by following the link in the email.
how_to_use.how_use_2: Allow the app to send notifications and use the camera and microphone. Location access is optional.
how_to_use.how_use_3: On the “Trusted People” page, add users by their unique KeyId. Once they accept your request, they will receive a notification and access when recording starts. You can skip this step.
how_to_use.how_use_4: Start recording from the main screen or the recording page.
how_to_use.how_use_5: Video and audio are automatically transmitted to a remote server and stored there. Data already transmitted will not disappear with the device.
how_to_use.how_use_6: In the free version, recordings are stored for up to one month. You can request early deletion or configure the deletion time and conditions in advance.

verify.title: Recording authenticity verification
verify.description: Drop a downloaded MP4 or evidence package here. The browser computes the file hash locally, then the server checks whether it matches a sealed evidence record.
verify.source_description: Verify an original MP4, an evidence package, or a direct recording link.
verify.how_local_text: We extract the evidence ID and compute SHA-256 locally.
verify.how_server_text: The hash is matched against E-stream's signed canonical record.
verify.how_result_text: You see the signature status, dates, issuer, and related metadata.
verify.drop_empty: Drag and drop one MP4 or evidence package
verify.drop_replace_hint: Or choose a different file from disk.
verify.drop_empty_hint: MP4 and .estream packages are supported. On mobile, use the package button to open documents/files.
verify.url_hint: The link must point directly to a publicly accessible MP4. The browser downloads and hashes it locally; the video is not uploaded to the verification API.
verify.mp4_selected_hint: The MP4 file itself will be hashed locally.
verify.package_selected_hint: The package contains the original MP4 and evidence manifest. The internal MP4 hash is verified.
verify.url_selected_hint: The MP4 was downloaded from the supplied link and hashed locally in this browser.
verify.messenger_warning_text: If you send MP4 as a video, messengers may recompress it and break verification. Send the evidence package as a file/document.
verify.only_mp4_error: Only MP4 files are supported for verification in this MVP.
verify.unsupported_file_error: Only MP4 files and .estream evidence packages are supported.
verify.package_missing_entries: Evidence package must contain evidence.json and video.mp4.
verify.package_unsupported_compression: This evidence package uses unsupported compression. Please use the original package downloaded from E-stream.
verify.url_invalid_error: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS link.
verify.url_pending_error: This video is still being prepared. Try the link again shortly.
verify.url_http_error: The video link returned HTTP status {status}.
verify.url_not_mp4_error: The link must point directly to an MP4 file, not to a web page or video player.
verify.url_empty_error: The link returned an empty video file.
verify.url_timeout_error: Downloading the video took too long. Check the link or download the MP4 manually.
verify.url_fetch_error: The browser could not download this link. It may be private, unavailable, or blocked by CORS. Download the MP4 and choose it as a file instead.
verify.processing_text: The browser is computing the SHA-256 hash locally, then the server will compare it with the canonical evidence record.
verify.processing_url_text: The browser is downloading the MP4 from the link and computing SHA-256 locally. The video itself is not sent to the verification API.
verify.fragment_title: Verified fragment of the source recording
verify.fragment_description: The fragment was created by the E-stream server from a verified recording. Its boundaries and link to the original are included in the signed data.
